worldcombat.skill.facade.summary: Grit through your own affliction. While poisoned, badly poisoned, burned, paralyzed or frozen the slam deals double damage, and the worse your health the harder it hits. Shoves the target back; Brutal hits harder still but makes you hurt yourself.
worldcombat.skill.facade.description.0: The slam deals about %1$s contact damage; it is doubled while you carry poison/badly poisoned, burn, paralysis or frozen, and the more health you have lost the harder it hits. It strikes only the first enemy it meets, and your status is not consumed.
worldcombat.skill.facade.description.1: On a hit, the target is shoved %1$s blocks along the charge; the lunge reaches %2$s blocks in total and ends early (a whiff) if it meets a block or cannot keep moving.
worldcombat.skill.facade.description.2: Advance speed %1$s blocks per tick, collision radius %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.facade.preference.brut: On: power ×1.15 and a longer shove, but on a hit you lose 6% of your maximum health and recover and cooldown are 2/4 ticks longer. Off: no recoil, a cleaner start.
worldcombat.skill.facade.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of charging. Larger values chase harder and whiff more in the open.
worldcombat.skill.facade.preference.ai.l: When on, the user may leave its post to grit through an attack; when off, it only charges what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.facade.description.3: A landed hit costs you %1$s of your maximum health (0 while Brutal is off).
worldcombat.skill.facade.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s wind-up, %3$s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s cooldown.
